title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of CSO partners in Central Asia

description.narrative:
This activity covers the overall programme management, coordination, and administrative implementation of a Sida-funded intervention aimed at strengthening civil society in Central Asia. It reflects the reporting organisation’s role in jointly planning, coordinating, and supporting activities implemented across the region, while ensuring effective use of funds and compliance with donor requirements.
Within this activity, the reporting organisation is responsible for programme coordination, financial management, monitoring and follow-up, reporting, and organizational support. The activity also encompasses joint planning processes, cross-cutting learning, exchange, and documentation that link country-level interventions and contribute to shared objectives related to civil society strengthening, gender equality, environmental sustainability, climate resilience, and accountable governance.
The activity supports and enables implementation carried out in different country contexts through structured coordination, long-term planning, quality assurance, and administrative functions, without duplicating country-level implementation activities that are reported separately.

provider-org.narrative: Sweden, through Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida)
